title: An asymptotic shape optimization problem for Riesz means of Laplacian eigenvalues
summary: We review our recent results on the problem of optimizing Riesz means of Laplace eigenvalues among convex sets of given measure in the regime where the cut-off parameter in the definition of the Riesz means tends to infinity. We show that for a certain range of Riesz exponents, the optimizing sets converge to a ball. We also present some new results where we optimize over disjoint unions of convex sets.
